short_metadata.title: Why Big Tech is Overrated
short_metadata.description:
Alright, gather 'round, corporate crash-test dummies.

Your favorite tech titan just "synergized" 10,000 human roles right out the door to fund their groundbreaking new AI. This cutting-edge bot's primary function? Confidently generating wildly inaccurate soup recipes, ranging from 'CPU Broth' to 'Algorithmic Avgolemono.' So, while thousands are updating their LinkedIn, Megacorp now has a multi-million-dollar digital chef who thinks your printer needs a dash of dill.

headline: A multi-billion dollar EV company recalling all cars because the touch screen won't let you roll down the windows

long_metadata.title: The Full Corporate Tech Reality Check
long_metadata.description:
Your multi-billion dollar EV company just recalled every single car because the fancy touchscreen won't let you roll down the damn windows. That's right, we're talking peak innovation holding your basic ventilation hostage with a single software glitch. Apparently, progress now includes mandatory hotboxing.
